conflicts: 5s 2S1/2 lifetime: 6.8(3) ns (Norton & Gallagher 1971, Hanle), 6.9(5) ns (Andersen & Sorensen 1972, beam-foil), 7.0(4) ns (Havey et al. 1977); the theory value quoted as 5.7(6) ns by Farooq-Smith et al. is lower.

4p 2P3/2 hyperfine constants: optical values 191.5(9)/63(2) MHz (69Ga) and 242.8(7)/39(2) MHz (71Ga) versus 190.794/62.52 and 242.434/39.40 MHz derived from the Daly-Holloway atomic-beam intervals; they agree within the optical uncertainties, the atomic-beam numbers are more precise.
4d 2D hyperfine A constants: Rehse et al. 2001 state that their signs correct sign errors of an earlier determination (Zhao et al. 1986, not opened).
Isotope-shift sign differs between lines: on 417 nm 69Ga is 40(4) MHz higher than 71Ga, on the 294 nm lines 71Ga is 114-115 MHz higher (as printed in the respective sources).
417 nm isotope shift: 40(4) MHz (Procter 2012), 39.6(3.5) MHz (Neijzen 1980), 33(35) MHz (Farooq-Smith 2017, uncorrected CRIS).
not_found: Lande g_J factors (measured): NIST ASD lists none; no source opened.
Precise (comb-referenced) frequencies of the 403.3, 417.2 and 294.4 nm lines: none located.
Measured lifetimes of 4d 2D3/2,5/2, 5p 2P, 6s, 5d and higher levels: none located in open sources (NIST A values for 287.5/294.4/294.5 nm exist).

Safronova-group all-order matrix elements, lifetimes and hyperfine constants for Ga I (Safronova, Cowan, Safronova, J. Phys. B 39, 749 (2006)): publisher page blocked, no arXiv version found; only the abstract (OSTI) was read. No theory rme entries are given.
Hyperfine constants of 5p 2P, 6s, 5d and higher levels; B(4d) for 71Ga: not located.
Original Neijzen & Donszelmann (1980), Daly & Holloway (1954) and Rehse, Bockel, Lee (2004) data tables: only abstracts or second-hand quotations were accessible.
Branching ratios measured: none beyond NIST A values (A(403) = 4.9e7, A(417) = 9.2e7 s^-1 as quoted by Marago et al. from NIST).
notes: Both stable isotopes have I = 3/2. Ground-doublet hyperfine constants come from atomic-beam magnetic resonance (Lurio & Prodell 1956; Daly & Holloway 1954 as reproduced in Fig. 1 of Marago et al. 2003); values labelled derived were computed here from the printed intervals. Rehse et al. 2001 quote 3-sigma errors. Isotope shifts follow nu(first)-nu(second); where the source does not state the sign this is said in the note. Extra fields beyond SCHEMA.md: isotope_shift_factors, hyperfine_A_ratio_5s_over_4p32, ionization_energy, mu_N. The UDel portal has no neutral Ga entry (only Ga+).
